_comment: Position templates a new incumbent inherits as a SETUP draft. Format for converting _builders/spec.json / the definitions workbook: one entry per position, slots by number. basis = rating basis key (section 6.4); topGoal = Top Goals measure text (section 6.3); plans = six monthly plans Oct..Mar (null = blank). The Smart Factory Manager template is exact from spec 6.2 and 6.6; the head and manager Score slots carry the interim company ramp from 6.2 (notes say so). Every other slot comes from Smart_Factory_2H_FY2026_Scorecards.xlsx and is added by import.

slots.measure: Validated savings from Smart Factory initiatives (PHP, cumulative)
